svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A UMAP plot of 900 single cells. The cells fall into three well-separated clusters, coloured blue, orange and green, each corresponding to one of the three cell types in the sample.
svg.text: UMAP: 900 cells sort themselves into groups
Each dot is one cell. Cells with similar gene activity land near each other.
